description: Returns one guide by slug: summary, first paragraph, how the procedure is filed (online, representative or in person), validity dates, official source domain, up to five key questions and answers, the date last checked and a link to the full guide. Closed or unconfirmed guides return only their status.

lang.description: Language of the guides: "es" Spanish, "en" English, "uk" Ukrainian. Default: Ukrainian for Cyrillic queries, otherwise English.

name: get_guide
title: Get a guide summary
